description: Telegram bot integration with message queuing and persistent conversation history

allowedChatIds.title: Allowed chat IDs
allowedChatIds.description: Chats the bot accepts messages from, besides the default chat. A private chat's ID is the user's ID; a group ID allows all its members. Messages from other chats are ignored and their chat ID is logged.

chatId.description: Default Telegram chat ID for outgoing messages. The bot also accepts messages from this chat.
chatId.title: Default Telegram chat ID

format.description: How outgoing messages are rendered. 'markdown' sends rich messages (GitHub Flavored Markdown) and falls back to plain text if Telegram rejects them.
format.title: Message format

maxImageSizeMb.description: Incoming images larger than this are rejected. Telegram's Bot API caps downloads at 20 MB.
maxImageSizeMb.title: Max image size (MB)

chatId.description: Target Telegram chat ID. Supports {{template}} expressions. Uses the extension's default chat if omitted.
chatId.title: Chat ID

format.description: Render the message as Markdown or send it as plain text. Use 'plain' when templated values may contain Markdown characters. Uses the extension's format setting if omitted.
format.title: Format

message.description: The message text to send. Supports {{template}} expressions.
message.title: Message

notify-telegram.description: Sends a message to a Telegram chat.
notify-telegram.label: Notify (Telegram)
